name: 常用短语
desc: 完形高频搭配 · 逻辑关系词 · 动词短语

questions.a:
## 卡片

**account for**　（真题年年见的万能短语）

| 含义 | 例句 |
| --- | --- |
| ① 占比 | Women **account for** 45% of the workforce.（女性占劳动力的 45%） |
| ② 解释 | How do you **account for** his absence?（你如何解释他的缺席？） |
| ③ 消灭/占去 | Disease **accounted for** many pioneers.（疾病夺去许多拓荒者的生命） |

## 图表作文模板（含义①）

> Mobile payments **accounted for** over 60% of total transactions in 2023.
> 2023 年移动支付占总交易量的 60% 以上。

## 同义替换

- 占比：make up / constitute / represent / comprise
- 解释：explain / justify / attribute to

## 辨析

account for 占比 vs. take into account 考虑到（完全不同！）
完形中见空格后跟百分数 → 优先 account for / make up

questions.q: be subject to / be prone to / be liable to 易遭受词族
questions.a:
## 卡片

三个"**易于/遭受**"短语，完形辨析高频：

| 短语 | 含义 | 感情色彩 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| be subject to | 易遭受；受…支配；以…为条件 | 中性 |
| be prone to | 易于（坏事） | 贬义 |
| be liable to | 可能（发生不快事）；负有法律责任 | 贬义/法律 |

## 例句

- The plan is **subject to** approval. 该计划有待批准。
- Children are **prone to** colds. 孩子容易感冒。
- You are **liable to** be fined. 你可能会被罚款。

## 同义替换

be vulnerable to / be susceptible to / be apt to / tend to

## 完形技巧

后面接**负面结果**（disease/mistake/damage）→ prone to
后面接**条件/规则**（approval/tax/change）→ subject to

questions.q: attribute...to / contribute to / devote to 归因词族
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 | to 的性质 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| attribute A **to** B | 把 A 归因于 B | 介词 → + doing/n. |
| contribute **to** | 促成，导致；贡献 | 介词 → + doing/n. |
| devote...to | 把…致力于 | 介词 → + doing/n. |
| lead to | 导致 | 介词 → + doing/n. |
| owe A to B | 把 A 归功于 B | 介词 → + doing/n. |

**核心陷阱：以上 to 全是介词，后面必须接名词/动名词，不接动词原形！**

## 例句

- He **attributes** his success **to** hard work. 他把成功归因于努力。
- Smoking **contributes to** lung cancer. 吸烟导致肺癌。
- She **devoted** herself **to helping** the poor. 她致力于帮助穷人。（√，不是 to help）

## 真题陷阱

> The economic crisis contributed to ______ (rise) unemployment.
> 答案：rising（介词后接动名词）

## 同义替换（归因方向）

result from（结果←原因，方向相反！）；A results from B = B results in A

questions.q: in terms of / with regard to / as to 关于词族
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 | 正式度 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| in terms of | 就…而言；在…方面 | ★★★（最常用） |
| with regard to / regarding | 关于 | ★★★★ |
| as to | 至于，关于 | ★★★ |
| as for | 至于（略含轻视/转换话题） | ★★ |
| when it comes to | 当谈到（to 是介词+doing） | ★★ |

## 例句

- The two cars differ **in terms of** fuel efficiency. 两车在油耗方面不同。
- **With regard to** your proposal, we need more data. 关于你的提案，我们需要更多数据。
- **When it comes to investing**, he is very cautious. 谈到投资，他很谨慎。

## 写作模板

> **In terms of** convenience, nothing can match mobile payment.
> 就便利性而言，没有什么能比得上移动支付。

## 提醒

- in terms of 后接名词/动名词，整句不能缺主语
- 完形考"在…方面"时，in terms of 是标志选项

questions.q: however / nevertheless / nonetheless 转折词族
questions.a:
## 卡片

**转折三兄弟**（完形逻辑题第一大类）：

| 词 | 语气 | 用法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| however | 中性转折 | 副词，需逗号隔开：However, he refused. |
| nevertheless | 更强："尽管如此仍然" | = nonetheless |
| nonetheless | 同上 | 正式文体 |

## 例句

- The task was hard; **nevertheless**, they succeeded. 任务很难，然而他们成功了。
- He is rich. **However**, he is not happy. 他富有，然而并不快乐。

## 完形决策表（逻辑题必背）

| 关系 | 标志词 |
| --- | --- |
| 转折 | however / nevertheless / yet / still / on the contrary / instead / rather than |
| 因果 | therefore / thus / hence / consequently / as a result |
| 递进 | moreover / furthermore / in addition / what's more / besides |
| 举例 | for instance / such as / a case in point |
| 让步 | although / despite / in spite of / even though |
| 总结 | in short / to sum up / overall / all in all |

**技巧：完形逻辑题先读空格前后两句的方向（同向/反向），再选词。前后反向→转折词。

questions.q: instead of / rather than / other than 区别
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 | 接法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| instead of | 代替，而不是 | + n./doing（介词） |
| rather than | 而不是（并列两端） | + 不定式/doing/n.（连接连词） |
| other than | 除了（=except） | + n./doing |
| more than | 超过；不只是 | 比较 |

## 例句

- Walk **instead of** driving. 步行代替开车。
- He chose to walk **rather than** (to) drive. 他选择步行而不是开车。
- No one **other than** Tom knew the truth. 除了汤姆没人知道真相。

## 真题陷阱

> The problem lies in the design **rather than** the execution.
> 问题出在设计而非执行。（rather than 连接两个对等成分）

## 完形技巧

- 空格两边是**对等的动词/名词**且表"取舍"→ rather than
- 空格后是**动名词**表"代替"→ instead of
- 含义"除了"→ other than / except / apart from

questions.q: cope with / deal with / tackle 应对词族
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 | 语域 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cope with | 应对，处理（困难局面） | 通用 |
| deal with | 处理；涉及；对付 | 通用 |
| tackle | 着力解决（难题） | 正式/写作加分 |
| handle | 处理，操作 | 通用 |
| address | 解决（问题） | 正式 ★★★★ |
| combat | 打击（犯罪/疾病） | 正式 |

## 例句

- She can't **cope with** the pressure. 她承受不住压力。
- The government must **tackle** unemployment. 政府必须解决失业问题。
- New measures to **address** climate change. 应对气候变化的新措施。

## 写作替换链（避免重复）

solve → 用一次后换：tackle / address / cope with / deal with / resolve / combat

## 辨析

cope with 侧重"顶住困难"；deal with 侧重"处理事务"；tackle/address 侧重"主动着手解决难题"

questions.q: give rise to / result in / result from 因果短语
questions.a:
## 卡片

**方向性极易考反！**

| 短语 | 方向 | 例句 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| give rise to | 因 → 果 | Automation **gave rise to** unemployment.（自动化引发失业） |
| result in | 因 → 果 | The crash **resulted in** injuries. |
| result from | 果 ← 因 | Injuries **resulted from** the crash. |
| stem from | 果 ← 因 | His anger **stemmed from** fear. |
| lie in | 果 ← 因（根源在于） | The answer **lies in** education. |

## 记忆口诀

in 向前导致（result **in** = 导致），from 回溯原因（result **from** = 源于）

## 完形技巧

判断空格前后谁是因谁是果：
- 因在句首 → give rise to / result in / lead to / bring about
- 果在句首 → result from / stem from / derive from / owe...to

## 真题语境

> The economic slowdown **gave rise to** widespread anxiety.
> 经济放缓引发了普遍焦虑。

questions.q: take into account / take sth. for granted 惯用搭配
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| take...into account/consideration | 把…考虑在内 |
| take...for granted | 认为…理所当然；**不珍惜** |
| take advantage of | 利用；占…便宜 |
| take charge of | 负责，掌管 |
| take place | 发生（无被动！） |
| take over | 接管 |
| take up | 占据（时间/空间）；开始从事 |

## 例句

- We must **take** environmental costs **into account**. 必须把环境成本考虑在内。
- Don't **take** your health **for granted**. 别把健康当作理所当然。
- Shopping malls **take up** too much land. 商场占据太多土地。

## 真题高频陷阱

take...for granted 两个义项都考：
1. 宾语从句常倒装：I took **it** for granted **that** he would come.（it 作形式宾语）
2. 阅读中多考"不珍惜"义：We often take our parents' love for granted.

## 被动陷阱

The accident took place.（√）The accident was taken place.（✗ 无被动）

questions.q: in favor of / in search of / in need of 介词短语族
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| in favor of | 支持，赞成；有利于 |
| in search of | 寻找 |
| in need of | 需要 |
| in terms of | 就…而言 |
| in place of | 代替 |
| in honor of | 纪念，向…致敬 |
| in charge of | 负责（人作主语） |
| in the form of | 以…形式 |

## 例句

- Most residents are **in favor of** the plan. 多数居民赞成该计划。
- They went out **in search of** food. 他们外出寻找食物。
- The region is badly **in need of** clean water. 该地区极需清洁水。

## 完形技巧

- 后接**被支持对象**且表立场 → in favor of（≈support）
- 后接**寻找目标** → in search of（≈looking for）
- being in charge of（人）vs. under the charge of（事被管）

## 辨析

in charge of 负责（主动） / in the charge of 由…照管（被动）：
The child is **in the charge of** a nanny. 孩子由保姆照看。

questions.q: no longer / not any more / hardly...when 否定短语
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 结构 | 含义 | 例句 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no longer / not...any more | 不再 | He **no longer** lives here. |
| hardly...when | 一…就…（倒装） | **Hardly** had he arrived **when** it rained. |
| no sooner...than | 一…就…（倒装） | **No sooner** had I sat down **than** the phone rang. |
| not until | 直到…才（倒装） | **Not until** midnight **did** he finish. |
| by no means | 绝不 | He is **by no means** stupid. |

## 倒装规则

否定词开头 → 助动词提前（部分倒装）：
- Hardly **had** he... / Not until...**did** he...
- 主句倒装，从句不倒装！

## 真题语境

> **No sooner** had the announcement been made **than** prices soared.
> 公告一发布，价格就飙升了。

## 记忆

hardly 配 when（H-W），no sooner 配 than（N-T）——"早(soon)于(when)晚(than)"

questions.q: put up with / come up with / keep up with 动词短语族
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| put up with | 忍受（≈tolerate / bear） |
| come up with | 想出（办法/主意）；提出 |
| keep up with | 跟上，不落后 |
| catch up with | 赶上 |
| come up against | 遭遇（困难/反对） |
| keep up | 保持（不下落）；继续 |

## 例句

- I can't **put up with** the noise anymore. 我再也无法忍受这噪音。
- She **came up with** a brilliant idea. 她想出一个绝妙的主意。
- Wages haven't **kept up with** inflation. 工资没跟上通胀。

## 完形技巧

- 空格后是 problem/difficulty 且表遭遇 → come up against
- 空格后是 idea/plan/solution → come up with
- 空格后是 pace/trend + with → keep up with

## 记忆

up with 家族按"动作方向"记：put up(忍受=撑住) / come up(想出=冒出来) / keep up(跟上=不掉队)

questions.q: as...as / not so much...as 比较结构
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 结构 | 含义 | 例句 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| as + adj. + as | 和…一样 | She is **as tall as** her brother. |
| not as/so...as | 不如 | It's **not so cold as** yesterday. |
| **not so much A as B** | 与其说 A 不如说 B | He is **not so much** angry **as** disappointed. |
| the same as | 与…相同 | 后接名词 |
| A is to B what C is to D | A 之于 B 如 C 之于 D | Reading is to the mind **what** food is to the body. |

## not so much...as 真题用法

> The problem is **not so much** technical **as** cultural.
> 问题与其说是技术性的，不如说是文化性的。（**强调 as 后面**）

## 倍数表达（图表作文必备）

- A is three times **as large as** B（A 是 B 的三倍）
- A is three times **larger than** B（同上，口语等价）
- **double / triple**：The figure doubled from 20% to 40%.

## 完形技巧

见 not so much → 找 as 配对；见比较级 than → 排除 as...as 选项

questions.q: range from...to / vary from...to 范围短语
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| range from A to B | （在一定范围内）变化，幅度为 A 到 B |
| vary from A to B | 同义，因…而异 |
| differ from | 与…不同 |
| differ in | 在…方面不同 |
| differ with | 与某人意见不同 |

## 例句

- Prices **range from** $10 **to** $50. 价格从 10 到 50 美元不等。
- Opinions **vary from** person **to** person. 观点因人而异。
- The two designs **differ in** color. 两款设计在颜色上不同。

## 图表作文模板

> The data **ranged from** a low of 5% **to** a peak of 40% between 2010 and 2020.
> 2010 至 2020 年间，数据在 5% 的低点到 40% 的峰值之间波动。

## 搭配拓展

a wide range of 各种各样的（= a variety of）
age range 年龄段；range of prices 价格区间

questions.q: prior to / in advance of / ahead of 时间短语
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 | 用法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| prior to | 在…之前（正式） | + n./doing |
| in advance (of) | 提前 | + n. |
| ahead of | 在…前面；领先 | + n. |
| in advance | 预先（独立） | 句末 |
| up to | 直到；多达；胜任 | + 时间点/数量 |

## 例句

- **Prior to** departure, check your documents. 出发前检查证件。
- Please book **in advance**. 请提前预订。
- She finished **ahead of** schedule. 她提前完成。
- Sales reached **up to** $1 million. 销售额高达百万美元。

## 近义链（"之前"）

before → prior to → in advance of → ahead of → preceding

## 完形技巧

prior to 的 to 是**介词**：prior to starting（√ starting 动名词），不接动词原形。
deadline 搭配：ahead of the deadline 提前；up to the deadline 直到截止。

questions.q: be aware of / be conscious of / be ignorant of 认知短语
questions.a:
## 卡片

| 短语 | 含义 | 色彩 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| be aware of | 意识到，知道 | 中性 |
| be conscious of | 察觉到（清醒地意识到） | 中性偏正式 |
| be ignorant of | 不知道，无知于 | 贬义 |
| be skeptical of/about | 怀疑 | 负面态度 |
| be optimistic/pessimistic about | 乐观/悲观 | 态度题常用 |
| be indifferent to | 漠不关心 | 负面 |

## 例句

- Consumers are increasingly **aware of** data privacy. 消费者越来越重视数据隐私。
- He remained **ignorant of** the danger. 他对危险浑然不觉。
- Experts are **skeptical about** the claim. 专家对该说法持怀疑态度。

## 阅读态度题词库

支持：supportive / approving / favorable
反对：critical / skeptical / opposed
客观：objective / neutral / impartial
**永不对**：indifferent（作者不可能冷漠）/ biased / puzzled
